source.notes: Elegant ivory-silk white-weddings look for all-portrait studio photo sets: portraits bleed into the cream beside restrained gold serif + script text, broken up by one procedural champagne-silk + leaf-shadow interlude. v2: body diversified per templateRules — mirrored chapter layouts, arch trio / invitation row / photo duo breathers, one floating_frame signature — so long songs no longer cycle a single text layout and the lone silk clip plays once. v3: bride/groom cards were the only Vietnamese headings in an otherwise EN-heading/VI-body film (fixed to match); their body was name-only (now a short, generic personality line per templateRules' repeat_depth pattern — 2 variants each); s10's body was silently English while its sibling body scenes (s06/s08) were Vietnamese (translated); the s06/s08/s10 repeat rounds all replayed their own base layout back-to-back (same photo-one-side/cream-text-panel frame every recurrence) — now alternate with their mirror layout and one full_bleed_quote photo-only breather per scene, so long songs don't visibly loop the same card.
